title: artemisia vulgaris var. gnaphalodes
intro: Artemisia vulgaris var. gnaphalodes, commonly known as Western mugwort, is a variety of the wormwood plant. This perennial herb is native to Europe and Western Asia, and is known for its medicinal and culinary uses. The health benefits of Western mugwort include its ability to support digestive health, alleviate menstrual cramps and symptoms, and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-spasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-microbial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils.
